title: Boundary mass of the truncation T⌞B_{t₀}: M(∂(T⌞B_{t₀})) ≤ 2M_V(∂T) + 2·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ_T({t₀ − h < |x| < t₀}) (parent step 9)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U, V ⊆ ℝ^P and t₀ ∈ ℝ with closedBall(0, t₀) ⊆ V. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U). Let R′ be an IMRep in U with carrier M ∩ B_{t₀} (B_{t₀} := ball(0, t₀)), multiplicity θ and orientation ξ, representing T′ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U). Then M(∂T′) ≤ 2·M_V(∂T) + 2·liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ_R({x : t₀ − h < |x| < t₀}). Here M = mass = M_U, M_V = massOn V, μ_R = R.measure, and the liminf is along 𝓝[>]0 in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (T T' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R R' : IMRep U (m + 1)) (t₀ : ℝ), closedBall (0 : Euclid P) t₀ ⊆ V → R.Represents T → R'.Represents T' → R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ ball (0 : Euclid P) t₀ → R'.mult = R.mult → R'.orient = R.orient → T'.boundary.mass ≤ 2 * T.boundary.massOn V + 2 * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * R.measure {x : Euclid P | t₀ - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t₀}) (𝓝[>] 0)
